content: Count the lines in every file and write the totals to STATS.txt, largest first.
I'll explore the project structure, count lines in every file, and write the results sorted largest-first to STAT

tool_input: {"command": "find . -type f | head -100", "description": "List all files in the project"}

content: Good. The non-.git files are `README.md`, `data/acme.csv`, and `data/blue.csv`. Let me count lines in each.

tool_input: {"command": "wc -l README.md data/acme.csv data/blue.csv", "description": "Count lines in non-.git files"}

content: Now I'll write the results to `STATS.txt`, sorted largest first.

tool_input: {"command": "printf '%s\\n' \"  4 README.md\" \"  3 data/acme.csv\" \"  2 data/blue.csv\" > STATS.txt", "description": "Write line counts to STATS.txt sorted largest first"}
